## trustworthy-llama

### Description and Rationale
Our team brings together data science expertise and operational aviation experience. Stefano Billeter is an engineer specialised in data science, with a track record of scientific publications (ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-0331-1644). Lorenzo Della Casa is a commercial airline pilot with a working knowledge of machine learning, contributing first-hand operational insight into flight operations. We believe this combination of analytical and domain knowledge will allow us to approach the challenge from both a modelling and a practical perspective.
